Liquid Cooling vs. Air Cooling Benchmark In-Depth (NH-D15, NZXT X62, & More)

We're answering the question of whether "liquid cooling or air cooling is better," ft. the Noctua NH-D15, Deepcool Assassin III, NZXT Kraken X62 / X72 (280mm, 360mm), and more. Sponsor: Buy Thermal Grizzly Conductonaut on Amazon ([https://geni.us/1D8Eeq](https://www.youtube.com/redirect?event=video_description&redir_token=QUFFLUhqbUowTzBsSXlSYWhKNElwOUVTU3JEX1E2R2JNUXxBQ3Jtc0ttRnRhMU1uOFF0MFI4bUxmQlJqSHZuVU9SMVh1SXNydnZHOEhGVVFmdjZIcXl5bThUaWQ4eWdVWTJwSmZmSEtCeWJ4WjY1Y1RCejVUQ0IwdTI0QjJvNmxDM1hVcS1VNlhvb2NqNTd5aURWRHpSeEVUWQ&q=https%3A%2F%2Fgeni.us%2F1D8Eeq&v=7VzXHUTqE7E)) or Hydronaut paste ([https://geni.us/Fsray](https://www.youtube.com/redirect?event=video_description&redir_token=QUFFLUhqa0JuSnhkODZFM3dPTFJOQldKNTNpVGQ4QWlxQXxBQ3Jtc0trR1RCMWlacDZJTUNyMlRXd1R3c0pDOFRIVjluQnctek1raWVFSkVpT05YTE5vYVladjVsc3pBX1k4bmxRdy1VV3FJQ1p1cWRNWmlZMnZ2SjVaSmVqWVA1LTVGcTJUWkF1T2pTZnBDQXVTenRKQVRXbw&q=https%3A%2F%2Fgeni.us%2FFsray&v=7VzXHUTqE7E)) Watch our deep-dive on CPU cooler testing methodology and learn why it's so hard to do right:    [• Why Most Cooler Tests Are Flawed: CPU Cool...](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fmTOJP4KOyk)   Methodology article available here: [https://www.gamersnexus.net/guides/35...](https://www.youtube.com/redirect?event=video_description&redir_token=QUFFLUhqbmtTa1NlSGNGQVY2VzZCcWVDM29NZ0NybVB3QXxBQ3Jtc0trOW5NN0plWVppWnRVUTF4cUk1SVBab0pmTUdNTGEzX3lQTXhram5QTGxUMi1kYXZ2ZGl5ZTlZUXp4aHM4dDB6WHJXbHgxc0JYZ2Y5Z2lFY2FtaUtMb094YjFFZ0oyZDVTMVFtTzV2WTNrOF84ZFlKcw&q=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.gamersnexus.net%2Fguides%2F3561-cpu-cooler-testing-methodology-most-tests-are-flawed&v=7VzXHUTqE7E) In this video, testing focuses on big air coolers versus big liquid coolers. We're testing for time-to-max temperature, noise-normalized thermals at 35dBA (and 40dBA), max fan speed thermals, and talking about compatibility, ease-of-installation, reliability and uptime, and liquid cooler failure rate and lifespan. Find the Noctua NH-D15 we used on Amazon: [https://geni.us/4VUjCZ](
